summary: Busy multi-lane Moggill Road with clearway tow-away and no parked cars.

drivers.seclusion: Line follows the carriageway beside a median; apartments and houses sit 12-26 m away on the footpath side.
drivers.access_and_room: No pull-in, verge or lay-by; only traffic lanes beside the line.
drivers.traffic: Heavy arterial traffic, junctions and a major roadworks site.
drivers.convention: Clearway and no-stopping signs; 2P signs are on the far kerb, no cars parked here.
